competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. The first hit installs a bomb that detonates after 2 turns with a 90% chance, and the second hit stuns all enemies for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Whenever you grant harmful effects on the enemy with your skill, you grant yourself Shield, Immunity, or Counterattack for 2 turns each if the effect is not already applied to yourself. In addition, decreases the cooldown of [Star of Explosion] by 1 turn if you have 2 or more beneficial effects after the turn ends. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The Shield will absorb a fixed amount of damage.
The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
